sources.entry: Codex Skill by klaudworks - Enables users to prompt codex from claude code. Unlike the raw codex mcp server, this skill infers parameters such as model, reasoning effort, sandboxing from your prompt or asks you to specify them. It also simplifies continuing prior codex sessions so that codex can continue with the prior context.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code plugin/skill that lets Claude invoke the Codex CLI (codex exec and session resumes) to analyze, refactor, or edit code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Claude Code skill that lets Claude Code run the Codex CLI through codex exec and session resumes for code analysis, refactoring, and editing. Before using it, the user needs the codex CLI on PATH with valid credentials, and can verify with codex --version. The skill asks for the model and reasoning effort unless the prompt already specifies them, and selects a sandbox mode, defaulting to read-only for analysis. It suppresses Codex's stderr thinking tokens by default (2>/dev/null) to keep Claude's context small, and the user can ask for them to be shown. The README's example shows a codex exec command with model, reasoning effort, and sandbox flags, followed by a summary of the output. It can be installed as a Claude Code plugin from a marketplace or as a standalone skill folder copied into ~/.claude/skills. Detailed operational instructions live in SKILL.md, which the README points to.
use_cases: Get a second opinion on code from Codex while working in Claude Code
Have Codex analyze a repository and suggest improvements
Delegate refactoring or code edits to Codex from Claude Code
Continue a previous Codex session with its context
Run Codex in read-only or sandboxed mode from a Claude Code prompt
how_to_run: Install the codex CLI and confirm it works with: codex --version
In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add skills-directory/skill-codex

Or standalone: git clone --depth 1 git@github.com:skills-directory/skill-codex.git /tmp/skills-temp && mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r /tmp/skills-temp/plugins/skill-codex/skills/codex ~/.claude/skills/codex && rm -rf /tmp/skills-temp
Ask Claude to use codex to perform a task; it will prompt for model and reasoning effort if not given
See plugins/skill-codex/skills/codex/SKILL.md for full CLI options and workflow
notable: Infers model, reasoning effort, and sandbox settings from the prompt or asks the user, unlike calling the raw Codex MCP server
Simplifies continuing prior Codex sessions so Codex keeps earlier context
Defaults to read-only sandbox for analysis tasks
Suppresses Codex stderr thinking tokens by default to save context window space
Installable as a Claude Code plugin marketplace entry or as a standalone skill folder
caveats: Requires the codex CLI installed locally with valid credentials
README notes legacy models such as gpt-5.5 are rejected for ChatGPT-account sign-ins
Thinking tokens are hidden by default and must be requested explicitly to view
README references a skip-flag permission gate in the example without detailing it here; full behavior is in SKILL.md
